description.en: Personal plugin market for the DeepSeek Harness: install plugins straight from GitHub repositories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的个人插件市场：直接从 GitHub 仓库安装插件。

description.en: Adds an MCP Servers section right below Models in the settings page: manage MCP servers per scope (user-local and each workspace), with search, a form or JSON editor, config import, enable/disable, edit and delete. Servers mount at runtime, no host restart needed.
description.zh: 在设置页「模型」正下方新增「MCP 服务器」分区：按作用域（用户·本机与各工作区）管理 MCP 服务器，支持搜索、表单或 JSON 两种新建方式、导入既有配置、启停、编辑与删除；保存后运行期直接挂载，无需重启宿主。
